dialogue.content: こんばんは21時からロールプレイを始めたいと思いますのでよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'd like to start the role-play session at 9 p.m. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: 理想のクライエント像などはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there an ideal client persona you'd like me to play?

dialogue.content: どんなタイプでもいいですよ
dialogue.English: Any type is fine.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: それでは開始します
dialogue.English: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか?
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 学校のことで悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with something related to school.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 嫌いな先生がいるんです。
dialogue.English: There's a teacher I dislike.

dialogue.content: それは困りますね
dialogue.English: That must be difficult.

dialogue.content: いまは学校行けてません。
dialogue.English: I'm not able to go to school right now.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: 音楽の先生なんですが
dialogue.English: It's my music teacher.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 僕にだけ態度が違うんです
dialogue.English: They treat me differently than everyone else.

dialogue.content: 面と向かって「お前のことが気に食わねぇ」と言われました。
dialogue.English: They told me to my face, 'I can't stand you.'

dialogue.content: そんな酷いことを・・・
dialogue.English: That's a terrible thing to say...

dialogue.content: その先生が嫌いで、音楽の授業中は歌ったりとかはせず反抗的な態度を取り続けました。
dialogue.English: I hated that teacher, so during music class, I kept up a rebellious attitude and didn't sing or anything.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 中学に入学してから最初の夏休みまでずっとその態度をとりました
dialogue.English: I kept up that attitude from the time I started middle school until the first summer break.

dialogue.content: （聴いています）
dialogue.English: (Listening)

dialogue.content: 最初に僕の態度が悪かったのか、先生が悪かったのか覚えていないけど、初めから仲が悪かった記憶はあります。
dialogue.English: I don't remember if my attitude was bad first or if the teacher was, but I do remember we didn't get along from the very beginning.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねちなみに学年と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, could you tell me your grade and gender?

dialogue.content: 今学校に通っていれば中学三年生です。
dialogue.English: If I were going to school now, I'd be in the third year of middle school.

dialogue.content: 女です。
dialogue.English: I'm female.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: 夏休み前の授業終わりに先生に別室へ呼ばれました。
dialogue.English: At the end of a class before summer break, the teacher called me into a separate room.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そこで「やる気ないなら授業に出てくるな」と教科書を投げつけられました
dialogue.English: There, they threw a textbook at me, saying, 'If you're not going to try, don't come to class.'

dialogue.content: 私はそのまま飛び出して、自殺しようと窓から飛び降りました。
dialogue.English: I ran out right away and tried to kill myself by jumping out of a window.

dialogue.content: え！そんな酷いことされたんですか？
dialogue.English: What! You were treated that horribly?

dialogue.content: 僕なんて誰も必要としてないんだってその時思いました。
dialogue.English: At that moment, I thought that nobody needed me.

dialogue.content: そんなことされたら悲しくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Being treated like that would make anyone feel very sad.

dialogue.content: でも運が良かったのか悪かったのか、骨折ですんでしまいました。
dialogue.English: But I don't know if I was lucky or unlucky; I ended up with just broken bones.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 本当に飛び降りてしまったんですね
dialogue.English: So you really did jump.

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: でも助かって、本当に良かったです
dialogue.English: But I'm so glad you survived.

dialogue.content: 今はもう痛みとか後遺症とかそういうのはないけど、
dialogue.English: I don't have any pain or after-effects anymore, but...

dialogue.content: 心は痛いです。
dialogue.English: my heart still hurts.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったら
dialogue.English: After something like that...

dialogue.content: 当時親は泣いてました。
dialogue.English: My parents were crying at the time.

dialogue.content: 心の傷は簡単には癒えませんよね
dialogue.English: Emotional wounds don't heal easily, do they?

dialogue.content: 僕も泣いたけど、僕はずっと「なんで死ねなかったんだ」と悔しくて泣いてました。
dialogue.English: I cried too, but I was crying out of frustration, thinking, "Why couldn't I just die?"

dialogue.content: そうなんだずっとそんな風に思ってきたのですね
dialogue.English: I see—you've been feeling that way all along.

dialogue.content: 今親が教師に裁判を起こして戦っています。
dialogue.English: Right now my parents are fighting a lawsuit against the teacher.

dialogue.content: 辛かったですよね
dialogue.English: That must have been so painful for you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 僕のせいで余計な争いが生まれてしまったと思うと、消えてなくなりたいです。
dialogue.English: When I think that I've caused this unnecessary conflict, I just want to disappear.

dialogue.content: 親御さんは味方してくれてるんですね
dialogue.English: So your parents are on your side.

dialogue.content: でも、それも辛いんだ
dialogue.English: But that's also painful for you.

dialogue.content: 「証拠がないから教師が悪いと断言できない」と裁判所は言っているみたいです。
dialogue.English: Apparently, the court is saying, "Without evidence, we can't declare that the teacher is at fault."

dialogue.content: 僕の言うことは嘘の可能性が高いって
dialogue.English: That what I'm saying is likely a lie.

dialogue.content: そんな
dialogue.English: That's awful.

dialogue.content: 周りの生徒は態度悪い僕しか見てなくて、生徒の証言は先生側に有利になっているって
dialogue.English: The other students only saw my bad attitude, so their testimony is in the teacher's favor.

dialogue.content: そう聞きました
dialogue.English: That's what I heard.

dialogue.content: 嘘だなんて
dialogue.English: To say it's a lie...

dialogue.content: 「別室で起こったことは目撃証言もない」って
dialogue.English: They say, "There are no eyewitness accounts of what happened in the separate room."

dialogue.content: 僕があの時死んでいればきっと問答無用で教師が悪いってなったはずなのに
dialogue.English: If I had died then, I'm sure the teacher would have been blamed without question.

dialogue.content: 中途半端に生きてるせいで、親も私も苦しいんだってそう思うの……
dialogue.English: Because I'm alive in this half-way state, both my parents and I are suffering—that's what I think...

dialogue.content: 本を投げつけられたのは本当なのに嘘だなんて言われたらとても悔しいよね
dialogue.English: It must be so frustrating to be called a liar when it's true that they threw the book at you.

dialogue.content: うん。。。
dialogue.English: Yeah...

dialogue.content: あなたはとても辛い状況なのに親御さんのことを気遣う優しい方なんですね
dialogue.English: You're in such a difficult situation, yet you're so kind to be concerned about your parents.

dialogue.content: たまに「生き残ってしまったのは、あいつを殺すためだ。」って考えてしまいます。
dialogue.English: Sometimes I think, "The reason I survived is to kill them."

dialogue.content: それほどまでに憎いんだよね
dialogue.English: That's how deeply you hate them.

dialogue.content: 母さんは好きです。でも父さんは嫌いです。
dialogue.English: I like my mom. But I hate my dad.

dialogue.content: 憎いです。
dialogue.English: I despise him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でももし僕がその先生を殺したら、それはもう僕が問答無用で悪人になります。
dialogue.English: But if I were to kill that teacher, I would undoubtedly become the villain.

dialogue.content: そしたら家族まで巻き込んでしまう。だから今は踏みとどまってます。
dialogue.English: That would drag my family into it too. So for now I'm holding back.

dialogue.content: ぎりぎりのところで踏みとどまっているんだね
dialogue.English: You're holding on by a thread.

dialogue.content: 母さんはずっと僕のそばに居てくれるから、母さんに迷惑かけたくないです。
dialogue.English: My mom has always been by my side, so I don't want to cause her any trouble.

dialogue.content: 父さんは普段家に居なくて、単身赴任してるらしいです。
dialogue.English: My dad is usually not home; apparently he's living away from the family for work.

dialogue.content: そうだよね
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい行違ってしまいました
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, our messages crossed.

dialogue.content: こんな時だけ親ヅラして裁判だけ起こしに来てる父親は嫌いです。
dialogue.English: I hate my father for acting like a parent only at times like this, just to file a lawsuit.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: お父さんはあなたの気持ちを解ってないってことなのかな？
dialogue.English: Does that mean your father doesn't understand how you feel?

dialogue.content: 多分分かってない。
dialogue.English: He probably doesn't understand.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: あなたとしては裁判なんかして欲しくないのに
dialogue.English: Even though you don't want him to pursue a lawsuit.

dialogue.content: 僕は先生が憎いです。父さんもそれは分かると言います
dialogue.English: I hate the teacher. My dad says he understands that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: でも僕は先生からお金を奪いたい訳でも、社会的制裁って言うんですか？そういうのをしたいんじゃないんです。
dialogue.English: But I don't want to take money from the teacher, or... what do you call it? Social punishment? That's not what I want.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 裁判で先生のことを話すのももう嫌なの。
dialogue.English: I'm tired of talking about the teacher in court.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: でも話さないと勝てないって
dialogue.English: But he says we can't win if I don't talk.

dialogue.content: 父さんは言います。
dialogue.English: That's what my dad says.

dialogue.content: 僕はお金なんていらないから先生をただ殺したいんです。許されるなら。
dialogue.English: I don't need money; I just want to kill the teacher, if it were allowed.

dialogue.content: 僕と同じようにベランダから突き落としてやりたいんです。
dialogue.English: I want to push them off a balcony, just like me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でもそれは許されない
dialogue.English: But that's not allowed.

dialogue.content: そんなに憎んでいるんだね
dialogue.English: That's how much you hate them.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: でもそれをしてしまったら、お母さんも悲しむよね
dialogue.English: But if you did that, your mother would be sad, wouldn't she?

dialogue.content: その先生のせいで僕は学校行けなくなったから
dialogue.English: It's because of that teacher that I can't go to school anymore.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 小さい頃から「勉強していい大学いかないと幸せになれない」って父さんに言われて来ました
dialogue.English: Ever since I was little, my dad has told me, "You can't be happy unless you study hard and get into a good university."

dialogue.content: 中学で勉強出来てない僕は幸せになれないんです。
dialogue.English: Since I'm not studying in middle school, I can't be happy.

dialogue.content: 生きてても仕方ないから死んでしまいたい。
dialogue.English: There's no point in living, so I want to die.

dialogue.content: でも母さんを泣かせたくない。
dialogue.English: But I don't want to make my mom cry.

dialogue.content: そんな風に感じているんですね悲しいですよね
dialogue.English: I see you're feeling that way. It's very sad, isn't it?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 何が幸せなんだろ
dialogue.English: I wonder what happiness is.

dialogue.content: 僕は死んでしまうのが1番楽だし、幸せだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think dying would be the easiest and happiest thing for me.

dialogue.content: きっと生きてても学校行ってないからお金稼げないんだろうし
dialogue.English: Even if I keep living, I'm not going to school, so I probably won't be able to earn money.

dialogue.content: いろいろ嫌なことが重なると、そんな風に思ってしまうのも無理ないのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: When so many bad things happen at once, it's perhaps understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんは生きてて幸せですか？
dialogue.English: Counselor, are you happy to be alive?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Let me see.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お金稼げるから？
dialogue.English: Is it because you can earn money?

dialogue.content: それは稼げた方がいいけれど必ずしもそういうことではないように思いますよ
dialogue.English: It's better to be able to earn money, but I don't think it's necessarily just about that.

dialogue.content: そうなの？
dialogue.English: Really?

dialogue.content: じゃあ相談員さんは何が幸せって思うの？
dialogue.English: Then what do you think happiness is, Counselor?

dialogue.content: 自分なりにできることをやっていくってことかな？そうすれば、上手くいってもいかなくても、それなりに納得できる
dialogue.English: I suppose it's about doing what I can in my own way. That way, whether it goes well or not, I can come to terms with it.

dialogue.content: 僕には何ができるんだろ
dialogue.English: I wonder what I can do.

dialogue.content: その答えはゆっくり探していけばいいのではないかと、私は思うけれどな
dialogue.English: I think that's an answer you can take your time to find.

dialogue.content: 今日はいろいろな話が出てきたので一旦整理してみますね
dialogue.English: We've talked about a lot of things today, so let me try to summarize.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは音楽の先生から酷い扱いを受けていて仲が悪い
dialogue.English: You were treated terribly by your music teacher and you don't get along.

dialogue.content: 夏休みの前に呼び出されて、本を投げつけられて、そのショックで自殺未遂をした
dialogue.English: Before summer break, you were called into a room, had a book thrown at you, and attempted suicide out of shock.

dialogue.content: それから学校へ行けなくなったが、そのことであなたのお父さんがその先生を訴えて裁判になっている
dialogue.English: Since then, you haven't been able to go to school, and because of that, your father has filed a lawsuit against the teacher.

dialogue.content: あなたとしては、裁判などして欲しくなくて、その先生を殺したいくらい憎んでいる
dialogue.English: As for you, you don't want a lawsuit, and you hate the teacher so much you want to kill them.

dialogue.content: でも実行したら、お母さんが悲しむので実行しないでいる
dialogue.English: But you're not acting on it because it would make your mother sad.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それとは別に、自分は勉強が苦手で幸せになれないから死んだ方が楽だとも思っている
dialogue.English: Separately from that, you also feel that since you're not good at studying and can't be happy, it would be easier to die.

dialogue.content: お父さんのことが嫌いでもある
dialogue.English: You also dislike your father.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今、あなたはいろんなネガティブな気持ちが複雑に絡みあって身動きが取れなくなっているように感じました
dialogue.English: I feel that right now, you have many complex negative feelings tangled together, leaving you feeling stuck.

dialogue.content: 沢山ある問題をいっぺんに解決するのは難しいので、一つずつ解きほぐしていくのがいいと思うのですが
dialogue.English: It's difficult to solve all these problems at once, so I think it would be good to untangle them one by one.

dialogue.content: いかがですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I agree.

dialogue.content: 全部は無理かもしれないです。
dialogue.English: I might not be able to do everything.

dialogue.content: どれから手をつければいいんだろ
dialogue.English: I wonder where I should start.

dialogue.content: 今一番困っているのはどのことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is the biggest issue for you right now?

dialogue.content: んー………
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 裁判かな
dialogue.English: The lawsuit, I guess.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 結果はなんでもいいから終わりにしたい。
dialogue.English: I don't care about the outcome, I just want it to be over.

dialogue.content: 裁判で話したくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to talk in court.

dialogue.content: お父さんに裁判を止めてもらうには、どうすることが一番よさそうですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think would be the best way to get your father to stop the lawsuit?

dialogue.content: 父さんはやめる気ないです。
dialogue.English: My dad has no intention of stopping.

dialogue.content: 裁判て難しいこと分からないんですが、話したくないって答えるのもいいのかな？
dialogue.English: I don't understand the difficult parts of a trial, but is it okay to just say I don't want to talk?

dialogue.content: やだって言っていいなら言えそうです。
dialogue.English: If it's okay to say I don't want to, I think I can say it.

dialogue.content: あなたの気持ちを強く伝えるのもいいかもしれませんね？
dialogue.English: It might be a good idea to firmly express your feelings, don't you think?

dialogue.content: もしそれで勝てなくなるって言われても、僕はもう喋りたくない。
dialogue.English: Even if it means we can't win, I don't want to talk anymore.

dialogue.content: それが今の気持ち
dialogue.English: That's how I feel right now.

dialogue.content: あなたの正直な気持ちを言ってみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about telling them your honest feelings?

dialogue.content: 言ってみる
dialogue.English: I'll try saying it.

dialogue.content: そうですねそれがいいと、私は思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that would be good.

dialogue.content: やってみます。
dialogue.English: I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 明日母さんに相談してみます。
dialogue.English: I'll talk to my mom about it tomorrow.

dialogue.content: 是非、そうしてみてください
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: やることが見えてきたきがします。
dialogue.English: I feel like I can see what I need to do now.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ今日は相談に来てくれてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは、お時間となりましたので、この相談を終了させていただきます。
dialogue.English: Well, our time is up, so I will now conclude this session.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.
